This was my first loan experience with "Hero Housing Finance" and it was very horrible, as a customer.

But not get Section letter. Since November-22 Don’t know why both below mention name told that will get it with in a 7 Days but not happened.
And suddenly Rs: 17563.00 Debited from my account as an EMI on 08th of November-22 I was shock before Loan Disbursement how can be possible Cut the EMI I Call Mr.Abhishekh about the this issue but can’t response form them long time. Also I also follow-up many time with them but not responding from HHF Team.
Mr.Abhishekh ignoring every message and call also they reply only (Aaj ho jayenga kal Ho jayega) but till date I never
Even till date there is no Disbursement or No Updating from them. I have a record each and every call and messages.
My request to HHFL higher authority is to please look into such cases very seriously that happens in your organization so you will not lose your reputation and genuine customers.

I will never recommend HHFL as a financial provider to anyone.....and if you are choosing HHFL as your financial provider then please be alert.

Don't know about other branches of HHFL but Borivali branch peoples are very rude and untrustable, senior level persons will make you fool by giving fake assurity of your loan disbursement.

In my case my loan procedure was almost done, disbursement was also done. I paid all applicable charges and I was waiting that my money to get credited to my bank account in a couple of days.
After some days at the last moment, the senior sales manager told me 'Sir your Document has some legal clause due to we can't proceed with your loan’. You can imagine after spending so much money on load procedure the financial provider company is telling you, sir, we can't process your loan. at this point what customer will do?

These people don’t check all legal things initially they just run to get their customers and loan process amount. they check legal things at the very last moment and tell you. (Between the time customer has already spent money on load procedure).On top of that, they will tell you loan procedure amount is non-refundable........this behaviour is very rude and unfair to the customer.

My request to HHFL higher authority is to please look into such cases very seriously that happens in your organization so you will not lose your reputation and genuine customers.

I will never recommend HHFL as a financial provider to anyone.....and if you are choosing HHFL as your financial provider then please be alert.

1. TATA Officer promise me for giving loan on 9 %, after sanction I received loan on 10 % & after 6-months loan % will be increased to 11.00 %.
2. After receipt of loan we have got request for decreasing the loan interest % as we have got permission Nagar rachan vibhag.  But these documents were not accepted by TATA. However, same documents I have submitted to other bank and got loan 8.5%.
3. Closing has been requested on 29th Nov. it will give 18th Dec. 15th days takes for sending closer note in 21st century for sending of closer note though digital system. However, for the reconfirmation of closer note after 3 days TATA officer took only 1 hrs. to reconfirm
4. After submitting the cheque for closer (after giving the payment on 20th dec & same day it was deposited), as per official took 7 working days and 14 working days will be required for receiving of original documents excluding Saturday, Sunday and holiday.  So it will take another 40 days to simply close the file.
In 21st century and world of digitalization, I need 2 months required to close my case in TATA capital.  Is TATA capital will pay my 2 months money loss?

featured_reviews.name: PamiUSA
featured_reviews.review_text: One star is much more for Tata capital housing finance limited.the way they treat the client "AFTER LOAN START"is  unacceptable. Not replying you back.

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: Very poor management, staff and bankers who doesn't knowledge how the process works, even the simpler ones. It's tedious sometimes to call the banker because he has half no knowledge at all. Asks for same documents again and again and not at once which is a wastage of your time and money. I did not ever think of TATA being this pathetic. numerous email sent but they keep sending you and bugging you with their automatic replies with the case IDs but not a single call or solution. You need to improve a big time. If needed ask me and employ me I will provide the solution. Its hectic now and I am actually frightened as its just a start and i am thinking how will be your after sale's and further processes and nightmares. Period.

featured_reviews.name: Prajwal Chipkar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had our home loan processed through this branch. Mr. Omkar was very cooperative and thorough with the process. He explained us everything in detail and made sure we were aware of everything. He was also quick to respond by mail for some queries. Highly recommended and the branch location is also convenient just opposite to Oberoi Mall.

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the branch to close my home loan, and I would like to sincerely appreciate Yukta Raorane for her excellent support throughout the process. She was extremely polite, supportive, professional, and generous in her approach. She patiently guided me through every step and made the entire experience smooth and hassle-free.

It’s rare to come across such dedicated customer service these days. Thank you, Yukta, for your kindness and assistance. Keep up the great work!

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited this branch for my home loan disbursement process. Omkar was incredibly helpful and ensured the entire experience was seamless. He took the time to thoroughly explain the procedure and provided sound, timely advice throughout. Thank you for the help.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Gaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s been a great experience with HDFC Dindoshi Branch. Dhruv Sir and Yukta Madam patiently listened to my queries and helped me resolve them. Great team and Thank you

Visited this branch again and great to see the team Yukta, Parth, Dhruv and Shubham who coordinated and resolved all queries. Thanks very much team and best wishes to you all.

featured_reviews.name: Kaklotar Jignesh
featured_reviews.review_text: Yukta was brilliant and outstanding in her help for entire prepayment. Procedure. Hope HDFC has more employees like her. Best regards to her.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: Yukta was extremely helpful and professional throughout the process. She guided me properly, responded promptly to all my queries, and ensured a smooth experience. Really appreciate her support and dedication. Thank you, Yukta! 😊👍

featured_reviews.name: abhishek dutta
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good experience with the HDFC BANK LTD, The way Ms.Yukta handled the customer & her polite behaviour towards each & every customer wins the hearts. We need such professionals in every organisation. I wish her all the best for her future endeavours.
